Package paint.shared.constants

Class PaintFileNames

java.lang.Object
paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames
public final class PaintFileNames extends Object
Centralizes the naming conventions for all primary data files used within the PAINT application.

The PaintFileNames class defines constants for CSV files (Recordings, Squares, Tracks), configuration JSONs, and other standard outputs produced or consumed by the pipeline modules.
